overview: The City Council and the Community Development Board held a joint public hearing on proposed zoning amendments for the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District. The bodies voted on several specific land-use permissions and requested detailed boundary and height options to be modeled for their next meeting.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Residents and developers shared feedback regarding housing density, student dormitories, neighborhood preservation, traffic, and public green space.

items.title: Parking for Lodgers (Accessory Use #7)
items.summary: Both bodies approved a motion to reduce the parking requirement for lodging accessory uses from one space to zero.

items.title: Doggy Daycare and Neighborhood Medical Office Permitting
items.summary: The bodies voted to require a special permit for doggy daycares, while keeping neighborhood medical offices allowed by right.

items.title: Marijuana Uses and Service Stations
items.summary: Both bodies voted to prohibit marijuana uses in the BA1, BA2, and BA3 sub-districts, while leaving service station prohibitions unchanged.

items.title: Purpose-Built Student Housing
items.summary: The boards directed planning staff and consultants to draft a definition and standards for purpose-built student housing to be formally reviewed at the next meeting.

items.title: Heights, Boundaries, and Massing Options (BA1, BA2, and BA3)
items.summary: Following a presentation of shadow and massing studies, both bodies approved a motion to review specific height and boundary options on June 24th before adjourning.
